components.css: :host{--paper:#FFFFFF;--ink:#15181C;--ink-2:#4B535D;--ink-3:#5F6873;--field:#8A929C;--rule:#D5D9DE;--track:#EEF0F2;--nominal:#2442D6;--nominal-deep:#1A33B0;--nominal-wash:#F1F4FE;--tol:#1A9A55;--tol-text:#137A43;--band:#D3EFDD;--out:#C8283B;--font:"Chivo","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;} .ds-char{font-family:var(--font);margin:0;color:var(--ink);max-width:520px;} .ds-char>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34% 1fr;gap:16px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);align-items:baseline;} .ds-char>div:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);} .ds-char dt{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-2);} .ds-char dd{margin:0;font-weight:600;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 18px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-char small{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink-2);} .ds-tb{position:relative;flex:0 0 132px;height:8px;background:var(--track);} .ds-tb i{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:25%;right:25%;background:var(--band);border-inline:2px solid var(--tol);} .ds-tb b{position:absolute;top:-5px;bottom:-5px;width:3px;left:64%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);}

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a CMM inspection report for a machine shop. White paper, graphite ink, one blue that marks what is nominal and what you can act on, one green that marks the tolerance field and in-tolerance results, and a red held back for out-of-range. Claims are not adjectives: they are characteristics, each with a nominal, a tolerance and a measured actual, and wherever a number can be placed against a limit a tolerance bar shows where it sits.

Density is protocol density: rows divided by 1px hairlines, sections opened by a 2px ink rule, and large real voids between sections instead of tinted bands. Everything sits on the same white sheet. Controls are labelled switches with named positions; the selected position turns solid ink. Depth comes from the parts themselves (three.js models of turned, ground and milled steel), never from shadowed UI.

Motion is instrumental. State changes are quick (0.15s); a measured marker settles into place on a long ease-out; the one authored moment is the probe sweep on the hero shaft, which measures each feature in turn once on load and is skipped under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: White paper only; sections separated by 2px ink rules and voids, never by tinted bands.
Blue is ink for action and nominal values, not a surface colour.
Every precision claim is nominal / tolerance / actual plus a tolerance bar.
Chivo throughout; figures are tabular and lining.
2px corners on everything that has a corner.
Choices are switches with named positions; selected = solid ink.

rules.name: The Nominal Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue marks what is nominal and what you can act on. It fills a button or a focus ring, never a section, band or closing block.

rules.name: The Out-of-Range Rule
rules.body: Red appears only when a value or input is outside its limits. It is never emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Green Means In-Tolerance Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to tolerance limits, the band between them and results that fall inside. A green square is a status, not a bullet.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number a buyer might compare (values, tolerances, phone numbers, counts, pay, dates) is set with tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The No-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at small size in a quieter ink; no tracked uppercase except the wordmark.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on the same white sheet. Separate with a 2px ink rule and a void, never with a grey or tinted band or a dark CTA box.

rules.name: The Two Rules Rule
rules.body: A 2px ink rule opens a section, a flag, a step, a person or a job; a 1px grey rule divides rows within it.

rules.name: The Hairline Corner Rule
rules.body: 2px or square. Pills and soft cards do not exist here.

dos: Do state every capability as a characteristic: nominal, tolerance, actual, and a tolerance bar where the number can be placed against limits.
Do open each section with a 2px ink rule and separate sections with the void (clamp 96–168px) on white.
Do keep blue for actions, links, nominal ticks and focus; keep green for tolerance; keep red for out-of-range and errors.
Do set every comparable number in tabular lining figures.
Do build choices as switches with named positions, selected position in solid ink.
Do end pages on a white closing block with the drawing drop zone and a named person with a phone number.
Do keep the probe sweep the only authored motion and skip it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't fill a section, band or closing block with blue, grey or any tint; the page is one white sheet.
Don't use a dark CTA box, a four-up stat bar, zigzag image/text rows or a render in a grey card.
Don't add shadows to cards, buttons or panels.
Don't round corners beyond 2px or use pill shapes.
Don't use red for emphasis or green as a decorative bullet.
Don't introduce new tints of the signal inks beyond the tokens above.
